F3 at B3 carries two columns: C1 on grid B3 and C2 0.80 below it (B'3, the stair-landing column). F3 is recorded once at B3 (its main column) and C2 at B'3.
Columns are recorded here once (they carry no mark on S-02/S-03); the plan does not say which C1 size applies — S-06 gives 0.30x0.30 below the ground floor and 0.25x0.25 above it.
